$doc: CE-4685 (DESIGN_LLM_Commander §5d; DESIGN_Stochastic_Units_And_Resolution §23.5 orders by KIND, X-5 'one level at a time'): a seated company over three STOCHASTIC platoons. The seat's orders reach a stochastic platoon by KIND (it runs the generic StochasticUnit* play, never a physical one); the scripted mind runs the company's OWN attack play (CompanyAttack — the seat offers his class's plays); inside the 600 m band a platoon hands over (AggregateUnit.Resolution Physical) and its squads (<platoon>/<s>) fight; reports reach the company before and after the split. One name per row (CE-3502). FEATURE scenario, no golden until two fresh runs agree. The four rows only the SCRIPTED mind can pass (the opening Move by kind, CompanyAttack on the first SPOT) carry "if": "scriptedMind" — a model run SKIPS them (L-3 ④). ⭐ CE-4686: ① the company now hears Red through its platoons' relayed SPOTs (HQ-3b); ③ a split platoon's men hit Red.

expect.name: a stochastic platoon is ordered by KIND: 1st Platoon runs the generic StochasticUnitMove
the company runs its OWN attack play, CompanyAttack, within 2 s of the first split (the scripted mind: near the enemy, attack the objective)
an aggregated platoon reports to the company
inside the band 2nd Platoon hands over (Physical, X-5)
the split platoon still reports to the company
its squads fight: a man of a split platoon fires
⭐ CE-4686 ① a platoon RELAYS Red's squad up: the company receives a SPOT from one of its platoons (HQ-3b)
⭐ CE-4686 ③ fire on the position: a man of a split platoon fires AT a Red man
